request: I'd like the app in light mode now, the dark screen is hard to read in the daylight when I'm outside the shop and the bright version is much clearer
remove planned per day

I'd like which weekdays moved above best pieces, I plan my week by the days first and then look at the top items, so the order should match that
I'd like the limit default set to 12000 instead of 4000, the bigger sales now go through the shop and the app should start from the higher figure
make the project price line bigger
I'd like the stat card moved below the biggest gifts section, I want to see the top gifts first and the summary number after them
rename it Check In
I'd like a 30 day trend line added, it shows whether the donations are growing or shrinking so I can plan the next drive
rename it The Book
I'd like the stems per week line bigger, I use that number to order flowers for the weekend and the faint text is too small to read when I'm busy
I'd like the colour changed to teal, the yellow looked too much like a warning sign to my clients and the teal feels calmer
I'd like the colour changed to orange, the teal felt too cold for the kitchen and the orange feels warmer for the lunch crowd
I'd like row gap 2 moved below the goal streak, I want to see the streak first and then the gap so the page reads in order
I'd like the app renamed Little Helper, Masjid Fund only covers one part of what the team does and the name should show the whole job
make last piece days ago bigger
I'd like the monthly default set to 3000 instead of 1500, the rent went up this year and the app should start from the new figure
make the price per unit line bigger

remove rent per month

make it purple
